release_contents: Cloudflare trusted-proxy fix (incident stabilization, Priority 1 of the 2026-09-23 DevOps incident-ownership pass). New App\Support\CloudflareProxies::RANGES (Cloudflare's published IP ranges only, never '*') wired via bootstrap/app.php's Middleware::trustProxies(at:, headers: X_FORWARDED_FOR|HOST|PORT|PROTO). Fixes a real, independent bug found alongside the hcdn 429 root cause: without trustProxies, Laravel took Cloudflare's edge address as the visitor, so every throttle:N,1 route (keyed by domain|ip) shared ONE rate-limit allowance across all visitors reaching the same edge, and audit logs recorded the edge IP instead of the real visitor. New tests/Feature/CloudflareTrustedProxyTest.php (8 tests, 395 total suite), mutation-tested twice (no-trustProxies and at:'*' both correctly break the expected subset). No migrations. No unrelated feature changes.

cloudflare_incident_2026_09_21_to_23: Full incident-ownership stabilization pass completed at the Cloudflare/DNS layer (separate from this git commit, tracked here since it is the load-bearing production context). Root cause of the HTTP 429s: Hostinger's own hcdn CDN layer rate-limiting per-client-IP, now seeing Cloudflare's small set of shared edge IPs instead of individual visitors after the nameserver cutover to Cloudflare (NOT a Cloudflare WAF rule — the zone has none; NOT Laravel; NOT LiteSpeed). Fixed by removing hcdn from the DNS path for all 6 hostnames (Client -> Cloudflare -> real LiteSpeed origin directly), confirmed via repeated A/B tests (30/30 clean, vs 27/30 through hcdn) and Cloudflare analytics (0 429s in every clean window checked since). Also fixed: www no longer CNAMEs to *.cdn.hstgr.net (double-CDN removed); DKIM (x3)/autoconfig/autodiscover/ftp records set DNS-only (proxied:false); missing sahittopata A record restored; SSL moved to Full (Strict) after verifying all 6 origin certs directly; HTTP/3 disabled pending the previously-failing-ISP baseline; SPF updated to include both Google Workspace and Hostinger under RFC 7208's 10-lookup budget (mail architecture kept on Hostinger SMTP — Option A — since Google Workspace has ZERO functioning mailboxes for the domain, confirmed via raw SMTP RCPT TO probing of no-reply@/support@/info@/security@/admin@/postmaster@/dmarc@, all returning 550 5.1.1; this is flagged as a remaining risk requiring the owner's own Google Workspace admin access, not something this session can or should fix). Pre-change rollback snapshot of the full zone is saved at cloudflare-snapshot-2026-09-21T1858Z.json (session scratchpad, kept out of the repo — contains origin/edge IPs).
